name: appforge-agy
description: Seventeen modular skills for Antigravity that forge any app: reverse-engineer it, architect it, AI-supercharge it, test it, rebrand it, and ship clean-room products.
suggestedPrompts: Reverse engineer an app using forge-recon
Design the architecture and schema with forge-architect
Add AI features to my app using forge-ai
Seed realistic relational mock data with forge-seed
Audit database RLS and security with forge-security
Compare my clone against the original with forge-diff
